description: Llama 3.1 is Meta's flagship open-weights model family, available in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes. It features a 128K context window and supports tool calling, making it suitable for complex reasoning and agentic workflows.

trainingData.description: Trained on 15+ trillion tokens from publicly available sources.

trainingProcedure: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and RLHF. Training used 30.84M GPU hours (405B) and 7.0M GPU hours (70B) on H100-80GB.

evaluation.performanceSummary: 405B is one of the most capable open-weights models available. Competitive with GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 on many benchmarks.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
May exhibit biases present in training data

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: RLHF alignment and extensive safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

licenseTerms: Separate license required for >700M monthly active users

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, cloud deployment, or through inference providers

hardware.70B: High-end GPU required, ~140GB VRAM for full precision
hardware.405B: Multi-GPU cluster required, ~800GB+ VRAM for full precision
